name: XLA_BALANCE_STATUSES
description: This table contains the status of the balance for a code combination identifier and allows the simultaneous execution of the balance calculation, the balance recreation and the balance synchronization.

columns.name: APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Functional area within a software suite of products. For example, Financials or Payroll.

columns.name: LEDGER_ID
columns.description: Self-contained accounting information set for single or multiple legal or management entities.

columns.name: CODE_COMBINATION_ID
columns.description: Account code combination identifier.

columns.name: BALANCE_SOURCE_CODE
columns.description: Indcates whether is supporting reference balance (A) or third party control balance.

columns.name: BALANCE_STATUS_CODE
columns.description: Code identifies the status of balance period: A: available for balance calculation. B : balance is currently processed by the recreation function in the second phase of the recreation. C: balance is currently processed by the recreation function; the recalculation phase is completed. 	 : balance is currently processed by the open period function. 	 : balance is currently processed by the recreation function during the rebuild of the balances. R: balance is currently processed by the recreation function in the first phase of the recreation. S:  balance is currently processed by the balance synchronization function.

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_PERIOD_NUM
columns.description: Effective period number of the latest period for which the opening of the balances has been completed successfully for the ledger, application and balance source.

columns.name: RECREATE_PARTY_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Abbreviated name that indicates the type of the recreated party.

columns.name: RECREATE_PARTY_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the recreated party.

columns.name: RECREATE_PARTY_SITE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of recreated party site.

columns.name: BALANCING_SEGMENT
columns.description: Key flexfield: balancing segment.

columns.name: NATURAL_ACCOUNT_SEGMENT
columns.description: Natural account segment from the accounting flexfield.

columns.name: ACCOUNT_TYPE
columns.description: Classification of whether an account segment value of an account distribution is an asset, liability, equity, revenue or expense account.

columns.name: WARNING_FLAG
columns.description: Used by the Balance Recreation. The recreation  of this balance status  has not been completed by a  previous Recreation  request. The next Recreation request will  complete the task but will  end with a warning.

columns.name: RECREATE_EFFECTIVE_PERIOD_NUM
columns.description: Used by the Balance Recreation to resume the task of a previous request that ended with a  failure

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_NAME
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: JOB_DEFINITION_PACKAGE
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the package name of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
